text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've finally finished the new 
choreography... For the 'Bring me some 
oxygen!' part of 'Tracen Ondo'! Would you 
mind taking a look?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Benissimo! That cheerful, allegro tune... 
I wonder how it'll be expressed... I'm 
curious.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you! Well then, here I go—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Bravissimo!! I see, an innocent smile 
directed at the audience...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It was like encountering a lovely fairy! 
To think that song could be expressed like 
that!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! Singing energetically while 
showing a cute gap with adorable moves... 
This contrast is sure to hit all the right 
spots!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Studying that trending live concert 
footage was well worth it. With this, I'll 
snipe right through the fans' hearts, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Who's that heart-throbbing Umamusume? Oh, 
her name is Royce-chan~!" ...Fufu!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Choreography with a brioso flair that 
makes the audience's hearts tremble... 
...Heh, quite the musical expression 
befitting Royce-san.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Live music concerts make it so easy to 
evoke deep emotions. It'd be a waste not 
to take advantage of that. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Next is a powerful Japanese taiko drum 
performance! Would you mind sharing your 
thoughts afterward?
